cmd: cd /app; ls -a .rehearsal; command -v sshd nginx git openssl sshpass curl useradd; id git; ls -d /git; head -2 /etc/os-release

mkdir -p /app/.rehearsal && cat >> /app/.rehearsal/REHEARSAL.md <<'EOF'
# Rehearsal: git+nginx deploy server
## Model
- sshd (password auth) -> bare repo /git/project -> post-receive -> /var/www/{main,dev} -> nginx :8443 self-signed
### S1: env check: sshd, nginx, git, openssl, curl present; no git user, no /git; sshpass missing
EOF
useradd -m -s /bin/bash git && echo 'git:password' | chpasswd && mkdir -p /git /var/www/main /var/www/dev && git init --bare -b main /git/project && chown -R git:git /git /var/www && id git

mkdir -p /etc/nginx/ssl && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 365 -subj /CN=localhost -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1" -keyout /etc/nginx/ssl/key.pem -out /etc/nginx/ssl/cert.pem 2>&1 | tail -1; ls /etc/nginx/sites-enabled /etc/nginx/conf.d

rm -rf /tmp/t; export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="sshpass -p password ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null"; git clone git@localhost:/git/project /tmp/t 2>&1 | tail -2; cd /tmp/t && git checkout -q -b main && echo "main branch content" > index.html && git add . && git -c user.email=a@b -c user.name=a commit -qm m && git checkout -q -b dev && echo "dev branch content" > index.html && git -c user.email=a@b -c user.name=a commit -qam d && git push origin main dev 2>&1 | tail -4; curl -sk https://localhost:8443/index.html; curl -sk https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html

echo 'git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main' >> /git/project/hooks/post-receive; cd /tmp/t && echo "main branch content" > index.html && git checkout -q main && git -c user.email=a@b -c user.name=a commit -qam x --allow-empty && time git push origin main dev 2>&1 | tail -3; cat /git/project/HEAD; curl -sk https://localhost:8443/index.html; curl -sk https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html

cd /tmp/t && git checkout -q -f main && git -c user.email=a@b -c user.name=a commit -q --allow-empty -m x && time git push origin main dev 2>&1 | tail -3; cat /git/project/HEAD; curl -sk https://localhost:8443/index.html; curl -sk https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html

export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="sshpass -p password ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null"; cd /tmp/t && git -c user.email=a@b -c user.name=a commit -q --allow-empty -m y; time git push origin main dev 2>&1 | tail -3; cat /git/project/HEAD; curl -sk https://localhost:8443/index.html; curl -sk https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html
